name: Apply grandfathering in the migration planner
description: Validates that grandfathering keeps existing customers on the current price and yields zero migration delta.

planSteps.description: Open the app home page, then click the 'Migration' link in the top navigation bar
Assert 'Customers affected' shows 0, 'MRR after' shows $145.00 and 'MRR change' shows +$0.00
Assert 'Customers affected' shows 3 and 'MRR change' shows +$50.00
